svg.title: Webhook Processing System - Smart-Contract Integration (Hybrid Pattern with Contract Awareness)

g.text: Phase 1: Identify Contract via Provider Order ID
OLD: Find oxorder by provider ID
: Contract found by provider order ID,
contains order ID - no separate query needed
If webhook is delivered multiple times (common):
1. Find contract by provider order ID ✓
Safe webhook redelivery without side effects
→ May indicate provider sent webhook before contract created
→ Contract may be CANCELLED or EXPIRED
→ Contract has orderID but order doesn't exist (data corruption)
